meta.source: DESIGN.md §5 — FMD2 Compatibility Contract (derived from FMD2 baseunits/lua/*.pas)
meta.groundTruth: §5.2 event rows + facade method tables are machine-verified by contract/tools/drift-check.ts against a fresh parse of the Pascal dispatchers and registration tables (LuaWebsiteModules.pas, LuaWebsiteModuleHandler.pas, LuaXQuery.pas, LuaImagePuzzle.pas, LuaDuktape.pas, LuaStringsStorage.pas, LuaCrypto.pas)

facades.name: TXQuery

constructors.name: CreateTXQuery
constructors.notes: (HTTP.Document | HTML string | none) => TXQuery instance (global function, LuaXQuery.pas:209-212)

methods.name: ParseHTML
methods.notes: instance method taking EXACTLY ONE argument: HTML string or stream (LuaXQuery.pas:45-56, 193)

methods.name: XPathStringAll
methods.notes: overloads by argument type (LuaXQuery.pas:91-148): (expr) => ', '-joined trimmed string; (expr, TStrings-list) => fill list, returns nothing; (expr, separator, node) => joined string; (expr, TStrings-list, node) => fill list

methods.name: XPathHREFAll
methods.notes: (expr, names:TStrings, links:TStrings[, node]) => fills both lists, returns nothing

methods.name: XPathHREFTitleAll
methods.notes: (expr, titles:TStrings, links:TStrings[, node]) => fills both lists, returns nothing

facades.notes: Fill-list overloads mutate the TStrings facade — the primary way modules populate TASK.PageLinks (§5.6). Query evaluation swallows all errors => empty (XQueryEngineHTML.pas:358-399); log WARN rate-limited per (module, expression template). JSON dialect modeled as node tree: json(*) steps + fn:data(); css("sel") registered.

facades.name: IXQValue
facades.notes: Result object of TXQuery.XPath; also nested via GetProperty.

facades.name: TStrings

methods.name: LoadFromFile
methods.notes: jailed to the job temp dir (§5.5)

methods.name: SaveToFile
methods.notes: jailed to the job temp dir (§5.5)

facades.notes: Also reachable as event globals (NAMES/LINKS) and as MANGAINFO.ChapterLinks/ChapterNames, TASK lists, HTTP.Headers/HTTP.Cookies.

facades.name: MangaInfo
facades.notes: Bound as MANGAINFO for GetInfo; unknown-property typo keys (e.g. Artist) silently no-op — case-sensitive LuaClass semantics (§5.1).

facades.name: Storage
facades.notes: MODULE.Storage — shared per-module KV store (§5.3); Storage['reload']='true' triggers the §5.9 bypass re-issue.

facades.name: HTTP

methods.name: POST
methods.notes: moves Content-Type from Headers into MimeType and rewrites text/html => application/x-www-form-urlencoded; charset=UTF-8 (httpsendthread.pas:730-747)

methods.name: Reset
methods.notes: installs the full default header set (below)

properties.name: Document
properties.notes: stream facade: ToString(=ReadString), WriteString, LoadFromFile, SaveToFile, Clear, Size (writable); POST bodies are written into it

headerSets.name: ResetBasic
headerSets.notes: Compress on => Accept-Encoding; zstd appended ONLY if the decoder is enabled (D13) — default omits zstd (documented divergence)

headerSets.name: AcceptImage
headerSets.notes: swapped in during the image download phase (httpsendthread.pas:919-922, uDownloadsManager.pas:369-370)

facades.notes: Redirects 301/302/303/307 followed AS GET, max 5 (default), Referer of the pre-redirect URL added (httpsendthread.pas:642-674); retry on >500 bounded by RetryCount, no delay (:623-629); URL massaging strips leading ':/', prepends scheme, MaybeEncodeURL (:612-616, 394-400); decompression gzip/deflate/brotli (+zstd per D13); a request succeeded iff Document.Size > 0 (:717).

facades.name: Crypto
facades.notes: require 'fmd.crypto'; single lib table = cryptomethods + synacodemethods (LuaCrypto.pas:496-500).

methods.name: DeScramble
methods.notes: (srcStream, dstStream); in-place same-Document calls supported (MangaGo.lua:264, 18Comic.lua:99, TonarinoYoungJump.lua:96)

facades.name: Duktape

methods.name: ExecJS
methods.notes: (js) => string; JS error => nil, never a Lua exception (LuaDuktape.pas:14-24)

facades.notes: require 'fmd.duktape'; node:vm (timeout 5s) with Duktape.enc/dec polyfill. JS-side CommonJS require loader (duk_module_duktape_init + Duktape.modSearch, Duktape.pas:88-89): module/exports with per-context caching, jailed to the synced lua/ tree (bare names + '.js'); 77 modules depend on it from inside JS (templates/Madara.lua:178-179, MangaGo.lua:206). JS-context print routes to the host log (Duktape.pas:90).

steps.name: link-fallback
steps.description: Link falls back from MANGAINFO.URL when empty.

steps.name: chapter-list-alignment
steps.description: Pad ChapterNames with '' / prune so it matches ChapterLinks count.

steps.name: trim-and-dedup
steps.description: Trim each link+name; case-insensitive duplicate chapter removal (SameText): the host DELETES the earlier index j, so the LAST occurrence's link+name survive.

steps.name: chapter-name-cleanup
steps.description: Trim(CleanString(RemoveStringBreaks(CommonStringFilter(name)))); optional manga-name prefix strip (OptionRemoveMangaNameFromChapter) — names feed output filenames (§7.1).

steps.name: remove-host-from-links
steps.description: RemoveHostFromURLsPair strips hosts from the chapter links pair; the same normalization applies to update-list scraped links.

capabilities.description: Module requires fmd.subprocess (TheBlank, RaijinScans, Comix); needs browser sidecar profile
templates/Madara.lua:169 run_html_load no-JS fallback (up to 76 Madara-family sites); Duktape image-decryption path is default-flow and unaffected
Python/webdriver bypass sites; needs browser sidecar profile

invariants: MODULE is bound for every event (LuaWebsiteModuleHandler.pas:47-49, 59-64); there is no ACCOUNT global — the account is reached only as MODULE.Account
PAGENUMBER is the only read-back global (LuaWebsiteModules.pas:210-212); URL is never read back after any call
First three table rows return codes; all others return booleans; SaveImage returns a string
Status constants are bound per return type: net-status for the code rows, account-status for Login/AccountState/CheckSite
BeforeDownloadImage globals are push-only; modules cannot mutate the download URL
Module property access is case-sensitive; unknown keys silently no-op on get and set (LuaClass.pas:94-169)
NewWebsiteModule() is available only during Init(); registrations missing ID or Name are dropped
GetInfo results are post-processed by the §5.8 pipeline (last-occurrence-wins dedup) before caching, diffing, or keying
Facade method/property names are machine-verified against the Pascal registration tables by contract/tools/drift-check.ts (extractable: TXQuery, Storage, ImagePuzzle, Duktape, Crypto)
